title: Bun's experimental Rust rewrite hits 99.8% test compatibility on Linux x64 glibc
summary: Bun's creator Jarred Sumner announced an experimental rewrite of Bun (originally written in Zig) in Rust, achieving 99.8% test compatibility on Linux x64 glibc, marking a significant milestone for one of the most prominent JavaScript runtimes.
problem_solved: Completes a language migration of a JavaScript runtime from Zig to Rust while maintaining near-complete backward compatibility.
why_valuable: Rust's mature ecosystem, memory safety guarantees, and tooling could make Bun more stable and easier to maintain long-term while preserving its performance advantages.
